content.rendered:
On the morning of October 16, 2019 the FlashAlert system will be conducting a test on their system response times. If you are subscribed to receive alerts from our district, you should receive a message as part of this test. If you do not receive an alert and believe you should have, please check your FlashAlert subscription or update the FlashAlert app on your mobile device.
For more information on our FlashAlert system, including how to subscribe, please visit: 

https://sites.google.com/a/sherwood.k12.or.us/ssd-new/district/emergency-information
